query:
SELECT candidate AS "candidate!"
                   FROM (
                       SELECT CASE
                           WHEN suffix = 0 THEN $1
                           ELSE $1 || '_' || suffix::TEXT
                       END AS candidate,
                       suffix
                       FROM generate_series(0, 1000) AS suffix
                   ) candidates
                   WHERE LENGTH(candidate) <= 50
                     AND NOT EXISTS (
                         SELECT 1
                         FROM users
                         WHERE LOWER(username) = LOWER(candidate)
                           AND deleted_at IS NULL
                     )
                   ORDER BY suffix
                   LIMIT 1
